data.tax_note: This is the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 itself and should be kept with the person's tax records.
data.title: Income Tax Assessment for 2025
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielau assessed Johanna Beispielacker's income tax for 2025 at €2,377.00; after deducting €2,916.00 in wage tax already withheld, a refund of €539.00 will be paid to her bank account. The assessment letter is dated 19 November 2026.
data.explanation: This letter from the German tax office (Finanzamt Beispielau) finalizes the person's 2025 income tax and confirms a refund of €539.00, which will be transferred to the account on file without any action needed. If the person disagrees with how the tax was calculated, they may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office — the app shows the deadline for this. Otherwise, the assessment becomes final after that window. A separate optional, free info session on 25 December 2026 is mentioned but is not mandatory.
